name: Onna Android ni yoru Shasei Kanri
original_name: 女アンドロイドによる射精管理
source:
20XX. The near future, a dystopic world where sexual prowess is suppressed by totalitarian rule.
You've been taken captive by Replicant K25 at the behest of the government, who classified you as a Special Needs Possessor and a dangerous threat.

K25 is a beautiful female android. Her mission: to "disable the threat".

It's best not to think of this as a hostile action. You are a free man. K25's technique is comfortable, and if you cooperate it can be a most amazing experience. Your hyper virility will keep her busy.
You may reciprocate her actions. Her model is custom designed for these missions.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE135769.html]DLsite English[/url]]
